subtitle: Share confidential information securely
wrap_intro: Your information will be protected with a one-time code. Send the code to your recipient: they can use it once to reveal the information.
unwrap_intro: Paste the secret code you received to reveal its information.
once_suffix: . Once revealed, the information can no longer be retrieved with this code.
lookup_intro: Check whether a code is still valid and how long remains before it expires.
lookup_notice: This check does not consume the code.
code_consumed: ⚠️ This code has been consumed and cannot be used again.
empty_fields: ❌ Please fill in at least one field.
copy_failed: Select and copy the code manually
bearer_notice: 🔓 Anyone holding this code can reveal the information.
recipient_notice: 👤 Send it only to the intended recipient, in a private message.
private_notice: 🚫 Never send it to a mailing list or public channel.
single_use_notice: 💨 One use: revealing the information permanently consumes the code.
network_error: ❌ The request could not be completed. If you were revealing a code, it may already have been consumed.
invalid_code:
❌ This code is no longer valid.

It may have been used already or expired. Ask the sender for a new code.
invalid_request: Check the request format and required fields.
config_failed: Unable to load the settings. Reload the page to try again.
err_ttl_required: TTL is required and must be a non-empty string
err_ttl_format: Invalid TTL format: '{value}'. Use seconds or a duration such as 30s, 5m, 1h or 24h
err_ttl_positive: TTL must be strictly positive; received {seconds}s
err_request_ttl_limit: Requested TTL ({requested} = {seconds}s) exceeds the maximum allowed ({maximum} = {max_seconds}s)
err_invalid_token: Invalid, expired or already used token
err_request_too_large: Request too large. Maximum allowed: {limit} bytes
validation_dict_type: Input must be a JSON object
